children: The chairman of Britain's John Lewis Partnership is confident the retailer will make a profit across the full-year after it reported a deeper first-half loss earlier on Thursday.
"I'm confident we'll be able to make profit across the full year," chairman Jason Tarry told reporters on a call on Thursday.
